name: Dual Marching Cubes
definition: Extracts an iso-surface by creating a dual mesh where each connected patch of triangulation in a cell becomes one vertex, and crossed grid edges yield quads connecting adjacent cells' patch vertices.
summary: Dual Marching Cubes is an isosurface extraction algorithm that generates manifold surfaces by unifying standard Marching Cubes fragments into polygonal patches and constructing a dual mesh.
